name: OpenBerth Self-Hosted Application Deployment Platform
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted application deployment platform for Node.js, Python, Go and static sites; deploy to your own Linux server with gVisor-isolated containers, automatic HTTPS, CLI and web management; no OpenBerth software subscription or vendor-imposed application quota.
watch_out: Requires an operator-provided Ubuntu server, DNS/domain, Docker, gVisor and networking; compute, domain registration, storage, bandwidth and external dependencies may cost extra. This is free software, not vendor-hosted free application compute. Review the installer and sandbox/security configuration before production use.
